title: Baristas
description: Prepare or serve specialty coffee or other beverages. Serve food such as baked goods or sandwiches to patrons.

tasks.text: Clean or sanitize work areas, utensils, or equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dishwashing of physical tableware
data analysis — Billing and payment processing largely automated

tasks.text: Prepare or serve hot or cold beverages, such as coffee, espresso drinks, blended coffees, or teas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on beverage prep in unpredictable kitchen space

tasks.text: Take customer orders and convey them to other employees for preparation.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Order taking automatable; customer rapport partly human

dwas.name: Communicate dining or order details to kitchen personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cleaning of food service surfaces

tasks.text: Prepare or serve menu items, such as sandwiches or salads.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cooking requires hands-on manipulation of real food

tasks.text: Wrap, label, or date food items for sale.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on packing of varied goods

tasks.text: Check temperatures of freezers, refrigerators, or heating equipment to ensure proper functioning.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI can interpret readings but hands-on assessment is human
physical manipulation — Physical collection and removal of trash

tasks.text: Describe menu items to customers, or suggest products that might appeal to them.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Menu presentation is live service interaction

dwas.name: Present food or beverage information or menus to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Demonstrate the use of retail equipment, such as espresso machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Food prep training is hands-on demonstration

dwas.name: Train food preparation or food service personnel.

tasks.text: Order, receive, or stock supplies or retail products.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Store supplies or goods in kitchens or storage areas.

tasks.text: Serve prepared foods, such as muffins, biscotti, or bagels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Carrying and serving food by hand

tasks.text: Stock customer service stations with paper products or beverage preparation items.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically stocking serving stations and dining areas

dwas.name: Stock serving stations or dining areas with food or supplies.

tasks.text: Provide customers with product details, such as coffee blend or preparation descriptions.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Menu presentation is live service interaction

dwas.name: Present food or beverage information or menus to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Set up or restock product displays.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Setting up displays requires hands-on placement

tasks.text: Weigh, grind, or pack coffee beans for customers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical measuring of ingredients by hand

dwas.name: Measure ingredients.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Create signs to advertise store products or events.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Promotional copy drafted; brand strategy human

tasks.text: Slice fruits, vegetables, desserts, or meats for use in food service.
